chatter.body: First complete assembly of the shaft support unit. Two bearing units on a common shaft, everything bolted to the base plate. Weights come straight from the solid models.
BOM checked against the layout drawing: 8 × M8x30 for the two support blocks, 2 clamp rings. Quantities match.
Split out as a sub-assembly so it can be stocked and sold complete. The spare part BOM carries only the wear items — bushing, spacer and screws.
Cast in EN-GJL-250. Bushing seats machined after casting, 0.02 concentricity between the two seats.
Wear part. CuSn12, replaced at service. Keep two in stock per unit.
Keyway at the drive end still to be confirmed with the gearbox supplier — kept in draft until then.
Drawing sheet issued at revision A. Bore tolerance and the two mounting holes are the critical dimensions.
